regions.breakdown: 能 (Nō) refers to the Noto region, 越 (Etsu) refers to the Echigo/Etchū regions (historical provinces), and 道 (dō) means road or way, often used as a suffix for expressways.

where_youd_see_it: On a highway or expressway in Japan, indicating the name of the route.
cultural_note: Many expressways in Japan are named after the regions they connect, often using kanji from old provincial names like Nō (Noto Peninsula) and Etsu (e.g., Toyama and Niigata prefectures).
